[IALC.4.1] Buffers libds returns to the caller fall in three classes.
**Borrowed** values (the callback contract) are owned and freed by
libds; the integrator copies out. **Typed handles** (`ds_json_t`,
`ds_fact_t`, `ds_schema_t`, `ds_engine_t`, …) are released by their typed
destructors (`ds_json_free`, …), which route through `DS_FREE` and are
therefore automatically consistent under any override. Neither class
needs new surface.
